greenWidthRule: arithmetic mean of the two archived starting widths, before applying the same width-factor grid
comparison: Two native Bayer green parities, same 19 holdout stars, same seven-plus-seven poses and masks, same broad model bank and thresholds. Repeat as separate diagnostics under calibrations A and B. Differences mix detector sampling, calibration, signal, registration and model adequacy; not a physical color determination.
